data.name: Hemkesh
data.gender_notes: Hemkesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from two Sanskrit words: Hem (gold) and Kesh (hair). The name Hemkesh carries the meaning “Golden Hair” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hemkesh usually hope their child will grow to embody golden hair and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hemkesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden Hair.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemkesh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hemkesh carries a rich cultural significance, particularly in the Hindu tradition where the deity Lord Varuna is associated with this name. He is known as the god of water, dharma, and cosmic law. The name Hemkesh signifies a person who is considered the embodiment of purity, beauty, and prosperity, just like the gold (Hem) that adorns the hair (Kesh) of gods and goddesses.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hemkesh holds deep significance in Hinduism. It symbolizes the union of gold (Hem) and hair (Kesh) within a person, which is believed to signify the interconnectedness of the divine and the human realm. This name is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be pure, wise, and prosperous individuals, embodying both worldly success and spiritual enlightenment. The name serves as a constant reminder of the importance of maintaining a pure and open mind, as well as a strong connection to the divine source.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Hemkesh signifies the one who is devoted to Lord Vishnu, symbolizing a pure heart filled with love and devotion towards the divine. It is believed that the name bestows blessings of happiness, prosperity, and spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Hemkesh is mentioned in the Mahabharata as the name of a king of the Vatsa kingdom. The name Hemkesh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Hemkesh was a powerful king who ruled over the Vatsa kingdom during the Mahabharata period. He is known for his military prowess and his alliance with the Pandava brothers.
